extra_vocab.en: a point in time when technology changes so fast that the future is hard to predict
extra_vocab.note: 多益中多出現在科技或產業趨勢的文章，常說 the technological singularity，指 AI 或科技大幅改變社會的那一刻。也可當作較正式的用字，表示「獨特、與眾不同」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: singularity 是可數名詞，複數是 singularities；指「科技奇點」時常寫成 the singularity，前面要加 the。

example.en: Some experts discuss different singularities that new technology may create.
example.zh: 一些專家討論新科技可能造成的各種奇點。

example.en: The speaker explained the technological singularity to the audience at the conference.
example.zh: 講者在研討會上向聽眾說明了科技奇點。

example.en: Some analysts believe we will approach the singularity within thirty years.
example.zh: 有些分析師相信我們會在三十年內接近奇點。

example.en: No one knows when machines will reach the singularity.
example.zh: 沒有人知道機器何時會達到奇點。

examples.en: Our guest speaker will talk about the singularity and the future of work.
examples.zh: 我們的來賓講者將談論奇點與未來的工作。

examples.en: The article asks whether the singularity will change how companies hire people.
examples.zh: 這篇文章探討奇點是否會改變公司的聘僱方式。

examples.en: Please read the attached report on the singularity before Friday's team meeting.
examples.zh: 請在週五的團隊會議前讀完附件中關於奇點的報告。

examples.en: Our new product is a singularity in the market; no other firm offers it.
examples.zh: 我們的新產品在市場上獨一無二，沒有其他公司提供。

confusable.diff: singular 是形容詞，意思是「單一的、單數的、非凡的」；singularity 是名詞。
confusable.usage: singular 是形容詞，修飾名詞，如 a singular achievement；singularity 是名詞，指「奇點」這件事或狀態。

example.en: Her singular talent helped the team win the new contract last month.
example.zh: 她非凡的才能幫助團隊在上個月贏得新合約。

confusable.diff: 拼法和字尾相近，但 similarity 是「相似之處」，和 singularity 的「獨特」意思相反。

example.en: There is a strong similarity between these two sales reports.
example.zh: 這兩份銷售報告之間有很高的相似度。

similar.diff: turning point 是任何事情的轉捩點，用途廣；singularity 專指科技快速改變、難以預測的時刻。

example.en: The merger was a turning point for our company's growth.
example.zh: 這次合併是我們公司成長的轉捩點。

similar.diff: uniqueness 指「獨特性」，比 singularity 常見，語氣也較日常。

example.en: The uniqueness of our design attracts many new customers every month.
example.zh: 我們設計的獨特性每個月都吸引許多新客戶。

example.en: The lab announced a major breakthrough in battery technology yesterday.
example.zh: 實驗室昨天宣布電池技術的重大突破。

example.en: Innovation is important for any company that wants to grow.
example.zh: 創新對任何想要成長的公司都很重要。

example.en: Reaching one million users was a big milestone for our team.
example.zh: 達到一百萬名用戶是我們團隊的重要里程碑。

derived.link: singular + -ity，把形容詞變成名詞，像 popular → popularity、similar → similarity
singular + -ly，形容詞加 -ly 變副詞，像 quick → quickly

senses.en: a future time when machines may become smarter than people

example.en: Many writers debate whether the singularity will happen in our lifetime.
example.zh: 許多作家爭論奇點是否會在我們有生之年發生。

senses.en: the quality of being different from everything else
senses.distinguish: 從上下文看，講產品或才能「與眾不同」時是此意思；講科技、AI 的未來時是「奇點」。

example.en: The singularity of her style made the brand easy to remember.
example.zh: 她風格的獨特讓這個品牌很容易被記住。
